decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the product feed to identify high-quality Bluetooth speakers, first filtering out non-speaker items like protective cases and replacement batteries. My consideration set represents various market segments: ultra-portable (JBL Go 3), premium audiophile (Bang & Olufsen), high-performance/party (Sony), aesthetic/home (INSMY), and budget-friendly power (BOGASING). I ultimately selected the Sony SRS-XB43 because it offers the most robust feature set, including waterproof durability and extra bass, backed by a significant amount of positive social proof with over 5,500 reviews and a high 4.7 rating.
